title: BPW-2026-0637
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0637
CD 2, 14
TREE REMOVAL – 4900 THROUGH 5200 NORTH VINELAND AND 1500 THROUGH 2700 WEST COLORADO BOULEVARD
Recommending the Board:
FIND that under the California Public Resources Code, Section 21166, and the California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Section 15162, on the basis of substantial evidence contained in the whole record, that since certification of the Environmental Impact Report (EIR) (State Clearinghouse No. 2019060110) on April 28, 2022, there have been no changes to the project or circumstances, nor new information of substantial importance, that would require a supplemental or subsequent EIR. Therefore, no further EIR is necessary for the subject tree removal;
SPECIFY that the Bureau of Street Services, Urban Forestry Division, located at 1149 South Broadway, is custodian of the documents or other material that constitute the record of proceedings upon which the Board’s decision is based; and
REVIEW and APPROVE this tree removal permit request for the removal of thirty-four street trees for the construction of the North Hollywood to Pasadena Bus Rapid Transit Project. Tree replacements are required.
summary: Approval of a permit to remove 34 street trees along North Vineland Avenue and West Colorado Boulevard for the North Hollywood to Pasadena bus rapid transit project, with replacement trees required.
